description_en: Queries detailed metrics for a specified instance
description_zh: 通过指定条件查询指定实例的细分指标
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-dashboard-details --instance-id airec-cn-o400whm78004 --start-time 1588521600 --end-time 1588521600 --trace-ids Alibaba --scene-ids test --metric-type xxx --experiment-ids all --match-types hot,emb,u2x2i,hilp,new, --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDashboardDetails

parameters.help_en: The start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The trace ID. This must be consistent with the data specifications
parameters.name: trace_ids

parameters.help_en:
The metric to query. This is an enumeration.

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: The total traffic volume in page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: The total traffic volume in unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: The traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: The traffic per capita.

USER\_PV\_STAY: The average stay duration per user. This applies to content-based scenarios.

USER\_UV\_STAY: The average stay duration per visit. This applies to content-based scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
查询指标，枚举选择

USER_ACTION_PV_COUNT 整体流量规模PV

USER_ACTION_UV_COUNT 整体流量规模UV

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO 流量转化率

USER_ACTION_UV_RATIO 人均流量

USER_PV_STAY 人均停留 （内容型）

USER_UV_STAY 次均停留 （内容型）
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: A list of experiment IDs. Set this parameter to \`all\` to query the overall effect at the scene level. The default value is \`all\`
parameters.help_zh: 实验ID列表，all（场景级别整体效果）。默认值为all
parameters.name: experiment_ids
